events.interaction_goal: Compare the complete flight costs and practical trip length, then select one round trip for hotel research without purchasing it.
events.scenario_brief: A three-day school closure gives Marcus, his husband, and their son time for a long weekend in Washington, D.C. A Thursday evening nonstop avoids missing school but arrives after normal dinner hours, while a Friday morning nonstop costs less and shortens the trip; Sunday returns include a midafternoon option that limits sightseeing and an evening option that gets the family home late before Monday.

events.interaction_goal: Compare the hotels by complete cost, sleeping arrangement, and daily travel time, then verify traveler and room details and book the selected flights and room.
events.scenario_brief: The family has selected the Thursday evening outbound and Sunday evening return. A Dupont Circle hotel offers two queen beds and easier access to their Friday plans, while a less expensive Capitol Hill hotel has one king bed plus a sofa bed and shortens Saturday's museum route; both can accommodate three guests, but their taxes, breakfast terms, and cancellation deadlines differ.
